verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-protection product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export of Radar data (rules, lists, reviews, analytics) in open formats. API endpoints such as review approval and value lists, the MCP server and the CLI are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
